title: Coordinate consistency tester
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number. Choose uniformly a coordinate $j$ and a Boolean string $y$ of length $2^n$. The tester makes three queries: the input bit at $j$, and the proof-table entries indexed by the sign encodings of $y$ and $x+y$, where $x$ is the sign encoding of the truth table of the $j$th coordinate function. It accepts exactly when the three answers satisfy the coordinate consistency rule: the product of the signs from the two proof answers equals the sign from the input answer.
